record.paper_title: Formal languages and arithmetic theories: recent results and open problems
record.original_question: Fix a base p. Semenov arithmetic is the first-order theory of the natural numbers with constants 0 and 1, addition, order, and the binary exponentiation predicate expp(x, y), interpreted as x = p^y. For formulas in Semenov arithmetic whose quantifier prefix has a fixed number of alternations between existential and universal quantifiers, what is the exact computational complexity of the decision problem?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 7. Determine the complexity of deciding Semënov arithmetic with a fixed number of quantifier alternations.
Just as for Büchi arithmetic, the complexity of Senënov arithmetic with a fixed number of quantifier alternations is an open problem [2].

artifact.self_contained_problem: Fix an integer base $p \geq 2$. Semënov arithmetic is the first-order theory of the structure $(\mathbb{N}; 0, 1, +, <, \exp_p)$, where $\exp_p(x, y)$ is the binary predicate that holds iff $x = p^y$. For each fixed $k \geq 0$, consider the decision problem restricted to sentences whose quantifier prefix consists of at most $k$ alternations between blocks of existential and universal quantifiers. Determine the exact computational complexity (matching upper and lower bounds, e.g., in terms of the polynomial hierarchy or weak EXP-hierarchies) of deciding truth in Semënov arithmetic for sentences with $k$ quantifier alternations.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2023–2024) on Semënov arithmetic establishes complexity bounds for the existential fragment (e.g., NEXP/EXPSPACE) and quantifier-elimination procedures showing non-elementary complexity for the full theory, but the precise complexity of the fragment with a fixed number of quantifier alternations is still listed as open, paralleling the analogous open question for Büchi arithmetic.

status_evidence.title: The Complexity of Presburger Arithmetic with Power or Powers
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds for existential and full theory of Semenov-style arithmetic; fixed-alternation complexity not pinned down.
status_evidence.claim: Complexity for fixed alternations in Semënov arithmetic remains unresolved; only specific fragments have tight bounds.

status_evidence.title: Semënov Arithmetic, Affine VASS, and String Constraints
status_evidence.snippet: Existential fragment decidable in EXPSPACE; full first-order theory of generalised Semënov arithmetic undecidable; fixed-alternation complexity not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Recent results address only the existential fragment, not arbitrary fixed alternations.
